note: Example prompts the skill should handle. They were not run through the skill-creator eval harness; the pipeline itself was verified by hand (see README 'What was tested').

evals.prompt: I have a flythrough Level Sequence (/Game/Cinematics/LS_Canyon, camera is called FlightCamera) in the level /Game/Maps/Canyon of my project D:/Proj/Proj.uproject. Make me a short low-res 360 video of it that I can watch on a Quest headset.
evals.expected_output: Runs doctor, setup with --source-sequence/--source-binding, calib (identity OK), a few stills to sanity-check, then clip + video; reports an mp4 tagged equirectangular, mentions the calibration result and the black-frame check, and offers the local viewer.

evals.prompt: my snow post-process flakes look totally random frame to frame when I render a panorama sequence from unreal, the effect uses a Time node. how do i get falling flakes that move smoothly across frames?
evals.expected_output: Explains that material Time is wall-clock, uses patch-time on the flake material (backup, MPC clock) and re-renders with the render clock (or --fixed-step as the alternative), and suggests measuring steadiness; warns that Time inside material functions and Niagara are not covered.

evals.prompt: just give me a 2048 wide equirect still of my level /Game/Maps/Atrium from the spot where the PlayerStart is, UE 5.8
evals.expected_output: Uses setup with --source-actor PlayerStart (or --location), calib at a frame with open space, then stills --frames 0 --width 2048 with setup --cube 1024 (noting that 1024 faces are untested), checks views, reports the PNG path.

evals.prompt: ue360 render came out all black
evals.expected_output: Checks the log for 'Failed to compile Material' (sampler type / equirect material), re-runs setup, verifies a rig and render target exist, reruns calib; does not blame lighting.
